info.name: Webex Admin Address Book BroadWorks Subscribers API

params.name: userId
params.description: The user ID of the subscriber on BroadWorks.

params.name: personId
params.description: The Person ID of the Webex subscriber.

params.name: email
params.description: The email address of the subscriber.

params.name: provisioningId
params.description: The Provisioning ID associated with this subscriber.

params.name: spEnterpriseId
params.description: The Service Provider supplied unique identifier for the subscriber's enterprise.

params.name: lastStatusChange
params.description: Only include subscribers with a provisioning status change after this date and time. Epoch time (in milliseconds) preferred, but ISO 8601 date format also accepted.

params.name: status
params.description: The provisioning status of the subscriber. This Parameter supports multiple comma separated values. For example : status=error,provisioned,provisioning.

params.name: after
params.description: Only include subscribers created after this date and time. Epoch time (in milliseconds) preferred, but ISO 8601 date format also accepted.

params.name: selfActivated
params.description: Indicates if the subscriber was self activated, rather than provisioned via these APIs.

params.name: max
params.description: Limit the maximum number of subscribers returned in the search response, up to 100 per page. Refer to the [Pagination](/docs/basics#pagination) section of [Webex REST API Basics](/docs/basics).

items.docs: This API lets a Service Provider search for their associated subscribers. There are a number of filter options that can be combined in a single request.

Provision a new BroadWorks subscriber for Webex services.

This API lets a Service Provider map a BroadWorks subscriber to a new or existing Webex user and assign the required licenses and entitlements for Webex and Meetings.

params.name: subscriberId
params.description: A unique identifier for the subscriber in question.

items.docs: This API lets a Service Provider retrieve details of a provisioned BroadWorks subscriber on Webex.

params.name: subscriberId
params.description: A unique identifier for the subscriber in question.

items.docs:
This API lets a Service Provider update certain details of a provisioned BroadWorks subscriber on Webex.
The updated items will not be immediately reflected in the response body, but can be subsequently obtained via the [Get a BroadWorks Subscriber](/docs/api/v1/broadworks-subscribers/get-a-broadworks-subscriber) API once the status has transitioned from the updating state to the provisioned state.

params.name: subscriberId
params.description: A unique identifier for the subscriber in question.

items.docs: This API will allow a Service Provider to remove the mapping between a BroadWorks Subscriber and Webex user.

Verify the likely success of provisioning a broadworks subscriber.

info.name: Send Consent User Move Email to Pending Broadworks Subscribers

params.name: subscriberId
params.description: A unique identifier for the subscriber in question.

items.docs: Allows a Service Provider to send the user consent move email to a subscriber who is currently in `pending_user_migration` state.
